tone.target: bright dual-lead Marshall crunch with tight mids
tone.profile: bright dual-lead Marshall crunch with tight mids
tone.summary: A classic Marshall Plexi-style chain, utilizing an OD boost for lead bite and a UK 45 amp model with a vintage cabinet to achieve bright, crunchy rhythm tones.
